doc: The captain choice of the game's OFFICERS_WINDOW (shipyard.c after buying a ship, transfer_main.c for a prize without a captain) and the hero's sheet over a hero-only ship: the candidates on the left (a tap selects one in the game's list: rows report click under their own id), the selected one's name, ship skills (TABLE_SMALLSKILL) and the game's facts (TABLE_SMALLOTHER) on the right, in the stock window's order. Inside a c-dialog sheet with no actions of its own: the game's «Назначить» stays at the foot of the right column while the list and the facts scroll on their own.

candidates.doc: [{id, title, image, selected, disabled, reason}]; none: the facts alone (the hero's sheet)

empty.doc: said in place of the list when nobody can take the ship

actions.doc: [{id, label, variant, disabled, reason, busy}]: the game's «Назначить», at the foot of the right column (not in the dialog's action row: on a 384 dp high phone that row would take the height the candidates and the skills need)
